menu.hotkeys: Hotkeys — tap to toggle, hold for momentary
menu.sniperHint: Share of the normal scroll speed.
noDevice.title: No pointing device found
noDevice.body: Connect a mouse or trackball, then press Retry.
pending.title: Device not applied
pending.body: Press “Use this device” to switch to the selected device. Settings stay hidden until the daemon grabs it.
tip.none: Trackball: no pointing device — click for settings
setup.title: Background service not installed
setup.body: The widget is installed, but the daemon that reads the trackball is not. Install it once: your password is asked in the terminal.
tip.uninstalled: Trackball: background service not installed — click to install
setup.stoppedBody: The service is installed but not running. Start it once: your password is asked in the terminal.
tip.stopped: Trackball: service stopped — click to start
help.speed: How far one ball turn scrolls. 100 % is the calibrated 85 counts per notch; higher is faster.
help.sniperSpeed: Sniper scrolls at this share of the normal speed.
help.smooth: High-resolution wheel events for smooth scrolling. Turn off for classic, discrete wheel clicks.
help.axisLock: Keeps a gesture on the axis it started on, so a vertical scroll does not wobble sideways.
help.exitOnClick: Any mouse button returns to pointer mode. Turn off to keep scrolling until you toggle it.
help.inertia: After a fast flick the scroll keeps going and slows down. Slow, precise movement does not trigger it.
help.sniperButton: Hold the %1 button to scroll at the sniper speed. The button is swallowed while scrolling.
help.hold: A short tap toggles the mode and keeps it; holding longer engages it only while the keys are held.
help.autoExit: Leave scroll mode after this many seconds without ball movement. Off keeps it on.
menu.sniperReserved: Left, right, middle, Back and Forward are reserved. Try another button.
help.inertiaTrigger: How fast the ball must move before a flick coasts, in notches per second. Lower is easier to trigger.
help.inertiaCoast: How far the coast runs after a flick. 100 % is the default; higher is longer.
help.sniperChoose: Pick a spare mouse button. Left, right, middle, Back and Forward are reserved and will be rejected.
stats.empty: No data yet — move the trackball.
stats.note: Estimates: 34 mm ball, ~1,600 counts/turn, ~20 notches/page. Counts are multiples; % is progress; the number in brackets is completed laps, trips or orbits.
help.batteryShowBar: Draw a small charge ring on the bar ball.
help.batteryLow: The badge and bar ring turn urgent at or below this percentage.
help.batteryPoll: How often the daemon asks the mouse for its battery. Plugging in updates it immediately.
stats.mouseEmpty: No mouse data yet — move the mouse or scroll the wheel.
stats.mouseNoDpi: Distance comparisons need the mouse DPI. Wheel and click stats are already collected.
stats.mouseNote: Wheel notches are physical wheel events; movement uses the reported DPI when available.
device.limited: This pointer type is recognised. More settings for it will arrive in a later update.
footer.keys: j/k move  ·  h/l adjust  ·  Enter select  ·  1–4 tabs  ·  r rescan  ·  Esc close
